answer: To protect an autonomous drone fleet along a river, micro-barometric entropy attestation mitigates Sybil attacks. Participating agents must record atmospheric turbulence during an ambient gale, cross-validated against fixed monitors on a cliff ledge. An attacker must operate dedicated physical airframes and expend propulsion power for each identity to capture true local entropy. However, predictive aerodynamic simulations can still reconstruct pressure dynamics under predictable wind currents.
